body: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
plain_description: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform that gives your organization complete control over AI interactions while keeping all data private and offline. It connects to any major AI model provider—local or cloud—in a single unified interface. The bottom line: one platform for chat, document search, image generation, voice, and team collaboration without sending data to third parties.
technical_description: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI frontend and platform written in Python (FastAPI backend) and Svelte (frontend). It supports any OpenAI-compatible API provider alongside local Ollama deployments, with a built-in RAG inference engine backed by nine vector database options (ChromaDB, PGVector, Qdrant, Milvus, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Pinecone, S3Vector, Oracle 23ai). The platform exposes a REST API, an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, and a WebSocket interface for real-time features. Deployment is available via pip, Docker (with :ollama and :cuda tags), or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm). It includes plugin architecture (Filters, Actions, Pipes, Tools, Skills), MCP/MCPO tool server support, RBAC with LDAP/SSO/SCIM 2.0, persistent memory, web search for RAG, multi-model conversations, image generation (DALL-E, Gemini, ComfyUI, AUTOMATIC1111), voice/video calls with multiple STT/TTS providers, and a PWA for mobile access.
title: Open WebUI
